papers.title: Prospects and Challenges of Translational Corneal Bioprinting.
papers.abstract: Corneal transplantation remains the ultimate treatment option for advanced stromal and endothelial disorders. Corneal tissue engineering has gained increasing interest in recent years, as it can bypass many complications of conventional corneal transplantation. The human cornea is an ideal organ for tissue engineering, as it is avascular and immune-privileged. Mimicking the complex mechanical properties, the surface curvature, and stromal cytoarchitecure of the in vivo corneal tissue remains a great challenge for tissue engineering approaches. For this reason, automated biofabrication strategies, such as bioprinting, may offer additional spatial control during the manufacturing process to generate full-thickness cell-laden 3D corneal constructs. In this review, we discuss recent advances in bioprinting and biomaterials used for in vitro and ex vivo corneal tissue engineering, corneal cell-biomaterial interactions after bioprinting, and future directions of corneal bioprinting aiming at engineering a full-thickness human cornea in the lab.

llm.relevance_to_user: 这篇综述讨论了角膜生物打印的进展，但完全未涉及AI或机器学习在生物打印中的应用，因此与用户关注的方向相关性很低。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a review on corneal bioprinting and biomaterials, with no integration of AI/ML into the bioprinting workflow, no experimental validation of an AI model, and no advancement towards autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 角膜移植是治疗晚期角膜疾病的主要方法，但面临供体短缺和并发症问题。
summary_zh.method: 综述了生物打印和生物材料在角膜组织工程中的最新进展。
summary_zh.result: 生物打印有望制造全厚度细胞负载的3D角膜结构，但面临机械性能复制等挑战。
summary_zh.validation: 文中未涉及实验验证，主要是文献综述。

summary_en.motivation: Corneal transplantation faces donor shortages and complications, motivating the exploration of bioprinting for corneal tissue engineering.
summary_en.method: This review surveys recent advances in bioprinting techniques and biomaterials for in vitro and ex vivo corneal tissue engineering.
summary_en.result: Bioprinting offers spatial control to fabricate full-thickness cell-laden corneal constructs, but challenges remain in mimicking native mechanical properties and cytoarchitecture.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation is presented; the paper is a literature review summarizing current progress.
